profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer @ Dell Technologies |  DevOps, AI, Mentor & Technical Leader
profile.summary:
With over three decades of experience in software engineering, I thrive at the intersection of technical innovation and strategic leadership. My career spans diverse industries, from aerospace and healthcare to IT, where I've consistently delivered robust software platforms, streamlined workflows, and mentored teams to achieve excellence.

Currently, as a Senior Principal Software Engineer and Chief Product Owner at Dell Technologies, I lead global teams in building scalable developer platforms that serve thousands of engineers worldwide. By integrating cutting-edge DevOps practices, I've reduced downtime and improved developer efficiency, enabling faster, more reliable software delivery.

My expertise lies in driving automation, moving into the AI/Agentic revolution and agile transformation, leveraging DevOps tools like Kubernetes, Docker, GitOps, AI , and Spotify's Backstage. Beyond the technical domain, I’m passionate about mentoring the next generation of engineers, fostering innovation, and aligning technical strategies with business goals.

Let’s connect to explore opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and growth!

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently leading the Developer Experience group as the AI Product owner helping the Dell's internal developers leverage well known AI coding assistant tools like Devin, Claude, MCP servers, Skills in order to drive innovation and rapid development.  
Led the development of Dell’s Internal Developer Platform (IDP) with Spotify's Backstage.io platform to streamline workflows and reduce toil for thousands of engineers globally.
Promoted to Chief Product Owner, overseeing the platform’s end-to-end vision, including user portal design, microservices integration, and global team coordination.
Led multiple cross-functional teams using Scaled Agile practices, delivering innovative features with consistent sprint velocity and stakeholder alignment.
Spearheaded the implementation of Continuous Testing Microservices within the ISG TechOps group, providing developers with automated testing, scanning, and coding standards enforcement.
Designed a microservices architecture that supported a broader DevOps ecosystem, enabling seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines and improving development efficiency across global teams.
Participated for 4 years in Dell's Technical Leadership Council TechRadar program working with other Dell distinguished engineers to anticipate, identify, and drive future technology trends and investments for Advanced Software Development Methodologies team
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · DevOps · Microservices · Backstage · Agile Application Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Design · Software Architecture · Technology Design · Leadership

positions.title: President
positions.description: Privately owned LLC for software engineering consultation work

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: At LivaNova, I played a pivotal role in leading system verification testing and automation for the Neuromodulation System. My responsibilities included transitioning to Ranorex to enhance regression testing and establishing continuous integration with Jenkins for efficient daily testing. Additionally, I led automation efforts for both Clinician and Mobile Applications across Android and iOS platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Jenkins · Android Development · C# · Ranorex

positions.title: IT Project Manager
positions.description: At Pride Automation, Inc., I played a pivotal role in managing technical teams and project operations, focusing on enhancing software delivery processes. My responsibilities included overseeing personnel and project budgets, driving business development initiatives, and demonstrating our solutions to potential customers. Additionally, I integrated Ranorex to streamline automation testing, ensuring efficiency in our software development lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Ranorex · Project Management · Business Development · Program Management · Customer Engagement

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
IV&V Co-Project Lead: SpaceX Cargo & Commercial Crew Vehicle
Co-lead team of engineers responsible for performing IV&V activities for both Cargo and Commercial Crew vehicles for SpaceX
Responsible for reporting directly to customer & NASA for all IV&V activities, including providing status reports, schedules, and providing all flight and planning deliverables. 
Performed duties of an IV&V team member including running simulations, creating test cases, performing analysis, reviewing design documentation and creating deliverables. 
Performed traditional managerial role for team of engineers including timecard approvals, performance appraisals, training, staff meetings, and coordinating staffing issues with Odyssey’s upper management.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Test Automation · Spacecraft · Simulations · Agile Project Management · Project Management

positions.title: Senior Development Engineer
positions.description:
Project Manager & System Engineer for Tiburon Jr - Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Program
Developed CONOPS & functional requirements for long duration UAV operations using the Intuitive Machines Tiburon Jr vehicle
Performed mission planning and autopilot programming/tuning on CloudCap’s Piccolo SL autopilot and PCC ground control station/software. 
Served as project manager overseeing schedule, staff, and purchases, as well as flight operations and regulatory documentation and guidelines

Verification & Validation (V&V) software engineer for Intuitive Machine’s Terrestrial Return Vehicle (TRV)
Produced testing plan for TRV flight software formal verification testing
Producing test descriptions, test scripts, and automation scripts to perform formal verification testing
Setup and implemented continuous integration testing system (Jenkins) for nightly builds and tests
Integrated and acquired Static Analysis Tool, Coverity, for all in house projects
Performed various flight dynamic Monte Carlo vehicle performance assessments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
NASA Orion Crew Displays and Controls Flight Software
Served as the primary embedded Verification Engineer for the Displays and Controls team.
Conducted requirements analysis, developed test plans, authored detailed test procedures, and executed verification tests for flight software.
Performed a trade study on Image & Object Recognition tools to support official displays verification testing.
 
Intuitive Machines – Terrestrial Return Vehicle (TRV)
Led formal verification testing efforts for the TRV flight software.
Developed comprehensive test plans, test descriptions, test scripts, and automation scripts.
Designed, implemented, and maintained a Jenkins-based Continuous Integration (CI) system for nightly builds and automated regression testing.
Evaluated, acquired, and integrated Coverity Static Analysis tool across all in-house flight software projects to enhance code quality and reliability.

positions.title: Sr. Commercialization/Software Test Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
QA Software & Hardware Engineer for Pressure, Pumping, and Chemistry group (PPC) with the Oilfield organization. Primary focus is customer requirements based testing of software and hardware solutions for multiple, new projects that will soon go into production for Schlumberger customers. Testing conforms to Schlumberger’s official QRC process for whether or not a product is ready for production. Produced test plans, testing documentation, writing testing scripts, performing testing, defect reporting and tracking, regression testing, and reporting to program management/stakeholders. Responsibilities also included setting up projects using Coverity's Static Analysis Tools and rolling out to the teams.

Projects included Real Time Equipment Monitoring (RTEM), Silo and DACS (Digital Acquisition and Control System) HMI software.

positions.title: Senior V&V Software Engineer
positions.description:
Verification & Validation (V&V) software lead for Emergent Space Technologies’ Cluster Flight Software Application (DARPA System F6 project). Primarily tasked with developing a V&V approach, verification group, processes and procedures, hiring and training testing staff members, and conducting the use case verification for the Cluster Flight Software Application. 

Acted as the company Verification and Validation lead tasked with developing engineers, grow V&V knowledge across the company, provide input into proposals and business development, identify and hire talented V&V engineers for the company.

positions.title: On-Orbit Mission Design & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Commercial Crew Transportation System (CCDev)
Acting as Mission Planning & Analysis coordinator for On-Orbit operations. Duties include trajectory planning  & 6 DOF simulations, event timeline generation, GNC requirements generation, facilitating technical forums for GNC and Mission Design, task coordination with Boeing project management & customers

Performed preliminary integration testing for on board flight software guidance algorithms for the commercial crew vehicle. Began initial requirements identification and use case definitions for mission design activities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated Materiel & Information Management Program
Acted as verification analyst for initial releases of the Integrated Material & Information Management (IMIM) software. IMIM project was designed to create and automate a common process, across multiple site locations, to reduce and improve sales of transactional spare parts to Boeing customers. Responsibilities included requirements generation, system use case development, test script development & implementation, test case execution, and defect/enhancement resolution. 

Iridium Satellite Operations
Acted as support software engineer for ground software applications for the Iridium Satellite constellation. Iridium's constellation consists of 66 low-earth orbiting (LEO), cross-linked satellites operating as a fully meshed network and supported by multiple in-orbit spares. Primary tasked with modifying existing ground software code (C++) for new features and defects, along with testing software prior to delivering updates to operations control center. 

Spaceway Satellite Operations
Acting as support vehicle engineer for two Boeing 702, geosynchronous (GEO) satellites for DIRECTTV High Definition television. Primarily tasked with monitoring the satellites’ general state of health and day-to-day operations in the operations control center.  Other responsibilities include data analysis, conducting both satellite and ground communication procedures, and responding to real time issues.

positions.title: GNC Flight Software Verification Technical Lead
positions.description:
DARPA Orbital Express Demonstration System (OEDS) Program
Acted as the Houston software verification technical lead primarily tasked with creating a verification group, processes and procedures, hiring and training testing staff members, and completing the requirements verification for the on-board guidance and relative navigation flight software. Also responsible for reporting verification activities and status to both Boeing program management and to the customer, DARPA. Throughout the OEDS mission, supported operations team with real time analysis for on-orbit operations and issues.

positions.title: GNC Orbit Flight Software Verification
positions.description:
Member of software verification testing team for NASA’s Space Shuttle On-Board Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) software for the Primary Avionics Software System. Verification testing expertise included system level regression and new functionality test for each software build release. Followed by reconfiguration testing based on specific flight design trajectories and mission constraints.

Reconfiguration GNC Technical Lead
Served as the GNC verification technical lead, responsible for overseeing multiple groups, overseeing 25 analysts. Served as the primary reconfiguration GNC technical interface within USA and the NASA community. Defined, managed, and coordinated verification testing schedules and deliverables for each Space Shuttle flight. Acted as reconfiguration GNC software process owner and supported function at project process and quality assurance meetings. Served as education coordinator responsible for education curriculum, development, and implementation for all GNC reconfiguration personnel. Continued to perform software testing and verification duties of a GNC orbit verification analyst

Reconfiguration GNC Orbit Technical Phase Lead
Acted as technical lead to the Orbit verification group overseeing 6 analysts. Tracked test cycle progress and ensured success for each testing cycle, reviewed and approved testing updates, and approved publication of testing results. Supported Reconfiguration GNC technical coordinator in overall coordination and workflow for the orbit testing. Continued to performed software testing and verification duties of a GNC orbit verification analyst

positions.title: GNC Orbit Flight Software Verification
positions.description:
Member of software verification testing team for NASA’s Space Shuttle On-Board Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) software for the Primary Avionics Software System. Verification testing expertise included system level regression and new functionality test for each software build release. Followed by reconfiguration testing based on specific flight design trajectories and mission constraints.

GNC Orbit Verification Analyst
Execution and analysis of simulations, generating testing results, documentation, and reports. Investigated, documented, and closed testing issues for test execution runs

company.name: Lockheed Martin Space Mission Systems and Services

positions.title: Cooperative Education Student
positions.locationName: Edwards Air Force Base, California · On-site
positions.description: During my internship at NASA Dryden Flight Research Center, I engaged in experimental flight research utilizing advanced military aircraft. My responsibilities included participating in high-stakes studies involving the F-18 High Alpha Research Vehicle and the F-16 XL High Speed Civil Transport Vehicle, contributing to cutting-edge aerospace research. This experience honed my technical skills and deepened my understanding of flight dynamics.
